import json, subprocess, hashlib, sys

MAIN='/workspace/submission/main.py'

def run(doc):
    p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',MAIN],input=json.dumps(doc).encode(),capture_output=True)
    return p.returncode, p.stdout.decode(), p.stderr.decode()

def msg(start, headers, body=b''):
    lines=[start]
    for h in headers:
        lines.append(h)
    text='\r\n'.join(lines)+'\r\n\r\n'
    return (text.encode('latin-1')+body).hex()

def base_cfg():
    return {
        "accounts":[
            {"id":"alice","default":"sip:alice@lab.test","aliases":["sip:alice@lab.test","sip:desk@lab.test","tel:+12025550100"]},
            {"id":"bob","default":"sip:bob@lab.test","aliases":["sip:bob@lab.test","tel:+12025550199"]},
        ],
        "peers":[
            {"id":"edge","mode":"access","accounts":[]},
            {"id":"relay1","mode":"relay","accounts":["alice"]},
        ],
        "ttl_ms":1000,"capacity":10
    }

def ev(t,peer,auth,egress,wh):
    return {"t":t,"peer":peer,"auth":auth,"egress":egress,"wire_hex":wh}

def show(name,doc):
    rc,out,err=run(doc)
    print('====',name,'rc',rc)
    if rc!=0:
        print('STDERR',err[:300]); return None
    j=json.loads(out)
    for r in j['results']:
        print(json.dumps(r))
    print({k:j[k] for k in ('accepted','replayed','rejected','live')})
    return j

REG=base_cfg()

def hdr_std(fromv,to,method='MESSAGE',target='sip:bob@lab.test',callid='c1',cseq='1',extra=None,cl=None,body=b''):
    if cl is None: cl=str(len(body))
    hs=[f"From: {fromv}",f"To: <{to}>" if '<' not in to else f"To: {to}",f"Call-ID: {callid}",f"CSeq: {cseq} {method}",f"Content-Length: {cl}"]
    if extra: hs+=extra
    return msg(f'{method} {target} SIP/2.0',hs,body)

w=T=hdrt if False else hdr_std('sip:alice@lab.test','sip:bob@lab.test',extra=['P-Preferred-Identity: <sip:carol@lab.test>'])
show('T1 ppi unknown',{"version":1,"config":REG,"events":[ev(0,'edge','alice','internal',w)]})

# T2 access From not alias -> identity

show('T2 from not alias',{"version":1,"config":REG,"events":[ev(0,'edge','alice','internal',w)]})
